_doc: FIX-1257/FIX-1261 — the roll-call questions that ARE a vote on a measure's passage (or adoption) in one chamber, lowercased with whitespace collapsed. ONE list, read by bill-status.ts (the nightly) and scripts/lib/bill-status-evidence.mjs (the cc-185 manifests), so the backfills and the writer cannot disagree. Picked by meaning from prod's distinct vote_question values (cc-185 read 2, 2026-10-03 23:01 UTC). NOT here: cloture, motions to proceed/table/recommit/commit/refer/discharge, amendments, 'On Ordering the Previous Question', 'On Consideration of the Resolution', the Senate's bare 'On the Motion' (the motion is named only in vote_title), 'On the Nomination' (a PN is not a bill), and both veto-override questions (a different stage). Concurrence questions ARE here: a concur vote that passed proves the measure passed this chamber (and the other), so passed_chamber is a true lower bound.
